notes: Annotation depth: CORE — 12 core services + plan-level + appeals_contact. Long tail of services (mental_health_*, substance_abuse_*, prenatal_visit, delivery_*, home_health, pt_rehab, habilitation, skilled_nursing, durable_medical_equipment, hospice_inpatient, childrens_*, diagnostic_test, outpatient_surgery_*, emergency_transport_ground, abortion, bariatric_surgery, routine_eye_exam_adult, acupuncture, chiropractic) NOT annotated. See ambetter-ca-2024-bronze-60-hdhp for full-depth template covering identical SBC layout.

Gold 80 signature: $0 in-network deductible (NOT a CSR variant — standard Gold tier achieves 80% AV via low cost-shares directly). In-network OOP max ($8,700) is HIGHER than Silver 87 ($3,000) because Gold doesn't have CSR enhancement; users pay more cumulative cost-share before hitting OOP.

This SBC is part of the cross-tier Ambetter triple (Bronze 60 HDHP / Silver 87 / Gold 80) used for Phase 5 cross-tier match validation. Same insurer + state + plan_year + plan_type — only the metal_level + actuarial_value + cost-share values should differ. findOrCreateCanonicalPlan must NOT score ≥0.9 on cross-tier merges.
Insurer mapping: same as other Ambetter fixtures — 'Health Net of CA' legal entity, 'Ambetter' brand, parser maps to 'Centene'.
Coverage period uses single-date format ('Beginning on or after 01/01/2024'); coverage tier is 'All Covered Members'. Both rely on parser fixes shipped in this PR.
MVS = 'Not Applicable' (individual marketplace plan); annotated as null.
